acceptance: Every CedarDB release UAT cell passes, or carries a documented skip that cites a reproduced engine error
SF0.01 and SF0.1 cells finish under 1200 s on the 4 vCPU / 16 GB release runner
CedarDB is back in the stage-2 release UAT shard with recomputed floors and a passing dry run
context:
When CedarDB left the gate, the release-gate runtime envelope for ('cedardb', 'tpcds_obt') was removed. Restore it with that reason. CedarDB cannot load the 5,041,336-row, 715-column TPC-DS OBT at SF1 within the release-host disk. In dry runs 3 (run 41243890531) and 4 (run 41255388284) the cell exhausted the 144 GiB runner disk. A local SF1 Parquet COPY reproduction (pinned image, mem_limit 8g) grew the data directory to 17.6 GB at 1,048,577 rows and kept growing, so the full load needs well over 80 GB.

Owner decision 2026-11-11 (choice dialog): v0.5.0 release-gate cuts approved as shipped; restore engines one at a time as each proves green: CedarDB first, then Presto/Trino at SF <= 0.1, then Databend and InfluxDB.

2026-11-11: PR #4138 (5341ac55ec) restored CedarDB to the stage 2 release gate with its own shard in release-v2.yml and trunk-uat.yml; TPC-DS OBT SF1 disk envelope kept; TPC-Havoc and TPC-H Skew get 1200 s timeout envelopes citing dry-run evidence; cross-scale floor 32 -> 44 pairs. Close after the next scheduled trunk UAT run shows every CedarDB cell passing and SF0.01/0.1 cells under 1200 s.
description: CedarDB was removed from the 0.5.0 release UAT by owner decision on 2026-11-01. In release UAT dry run 5 (run 41309974530, stage 2 cedardb, 8 GiB container) these cells failed: tpcdi QV1/QAQ5/QAQ7 at all scales; read_primitives (aggregation_distinct, intrinsic_to_date, window_moving_frame, json_*); write_primitives (insert_* at setup); transaction_primitives (commit, rollback, savepoint); and tpchavoc at SF0.01 (1_v1, 4_v7, 16_v7, 17_v7, 17_v10). tpchavoc and tpch_skew timed out at 1200 s even at SF0.01 and SF0.1, and vector_search exits 1. The tpcds_obt SF1 disk envelope stays.
